author: Fextralife
description:
The Expanse Osris Reborn Gameplay First Look - The Next Mass Effect?
In this video, we're going to be taking a first look at The Expanse Orisis Reborn and break down everything you need to know from the upcoming closed-beta to the core gameplay mechanics. This is a game that is going into closed-beta on April 22nd on Xbox, Steam, and PS5. We’ll talk about how you can join the beta, what kind of game this is shaping up to be, and take a closer look at combat, skill trees, dialogue options, space travel, and the locations you’ll be able to explore. Whether you’re a fan of RPG mechanics or just excited about exploring the universe of The Expanse, there’s plenty here to unpack.
